camel_example: aliyun alb CreateLoadBalancer --region cn-hangzhou --LoadBalancerEdition Standard --LoadBalancerBillingConfig.PayType PostPay --ZoneMappings.1.EipType Common --VpcId 'vpc-bp1b49rqrybk45nio0000' --LoadBalancerBillingConfig.BandwidthPackageId 'cbwp-bp1vevu8h3ieh0000' --ZoneMappings.1.ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-a' --ZoneMappings.1.AllocationId 'eip-bp1aedxso6u80u0qf0000' --ZoneMappings.1.IntranetAddress '192.168.10.1' --AddressType Internet --ZoneMappings.1.VSwitchId 'vsw-sersdf0000' --method POST --force
description_en: Create an application load balancer in a specified region
description_zh: 在指定地域创建应用型负载均衡实例
kebab_example: aliyun alb create-load-balancer --vpc-id vpc-bp1b49rqrybk45nio0000 --address-type Internet --zone-mappings IntranetAddress=192.168.10.1 ZoneId=cn-hangzhou-a VSwitchId=vsw-sersdf0000 AllocationId=eip-bp1aedxso6u80u0qf0000 EipType=Common --load-balancer-edition Standard --load-balancer-billing-config BandwidthPackageId=cbwp-bp1vevu8h3ieh0000 PayType=PostPay --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLoadBalancer

parameters.help_en:
A client token to ensure the idempotency of the request.

You can generate a unique value from your client for each request. The `ClientToken` parameter supports only ASCII characters.

If you omit this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without creating the Application Load Balancer instance. The system checks for required parameters, the request format, and service limits. If the request fails the check, an error is returned. If the request passes the check, the system returns the `DryRunOperation` error code.

false (default): sends a normal request. If the request passes the check, the system returns an HTTP 2xx status code and performs the operation
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建应用型负载均衡实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式和业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC for the Application Load Balancer instance
parameters.help_zh: 应用型负载均衡实例的专有网络ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The address type of the Application Load Balancer. Valid values:

Internet: The load balancer is assigned a public IP address. Its domain name is resolved to the public IP address, allowing access from the public network.

Intranet: The load balancer is assigned a private IP address. Its domain name is resolved to the private IP address, allowing access only from the private network of the VPC where the load balancer is deployed
parameters.help_zh:
应用型负载均衡的地址类型。取值：

Internet：负载均衡具有公网IP地址，DNS域名被解析到公网IP，因此可以在公网环境访问。

Intranet：负载均衡只有私网IP地址，DNS域名被解析到私网IP，因此只能被负载均衡所在VPC的内网环境访问
parameters.name: address_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Application Load Balancer instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters long. It must start with a letter, a Chinese character, or a digit, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces
parameters.help_zh:
应用型负载均衡实例名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以字母、中文或数字开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格
parameters.name: load_balancer_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable deletion protection. Valid values:

true: Enables deletion protection.

false (default): Disables deletion protection
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启删除保护。取值：

true：开启。
false（默认值）：关闭
parameters.name: deletion_protection_enabled

fields.help_en:
The reason for enabling modification protection.

The reason must be 2 to 128 characters long. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

This parameter is effective only when Status is set to ConsoleProtection
fields.help_zh:
输入开启修改保护的原因。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。

仅在Status为ConsoleProtection时该参数有效且合法
fields.name: reason

fields.help_en:
The modification protection status of the Application Load Balancer instance. Valid values:

NonProtection: Modification protection is disabled. If you specify a value for Reason, the value is cleared.

ConsoleProtection: Console-based modification protection is enabled. If you specify a value for Reason, the value takes effect.

If you set the value to ConsoleProtection, you cannot modify the instance in the Application Load Balancer console. However, you can still modify it by calling API operations
fields.help_zh:
应用型负载均衡实例的修改保护状态。取值：

NonProtection：不开启修改保护。如有配置Reason，Reason会被强制置空。

ConsoleProtection：开启控制台修改保护。如有配置Reason，Reason可生效。

当取值为ConsoleProtection，即开启修改保护后，用户不能通过负载均衡控制台修改实例配置，但可以通过调用API修改实例配置
fields.name: status

fields.help_en: The ID of the Elastic IP address (EIP) to associate with the public-facing instance
fields.name: allocation_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the Elastic IP address. Valid values:

Common (default): an Elastic IP address.

Anycast: an Anycast EIP.

For regions that support binding Anycast EIPs to an Application Load Balancer instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460727.html
fields.help_zh:
弹性公网IP的类型。取值：

Common（默认值）：弹性公网IP。

Anycast：任播弹性公网IP。

ALB支持绑定Anycast EIP的地域，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460727.html
fields.name: eip_type

fields.help_en: The ID of the subnet in the specified availability zone. Each availability zone can be mapped to only one subnet
fields.help_zh: 可用区对应的交换机，每个可用区只能使用一台交换机和一个子网。最多支持添加10个可用区。若当前地域支持2个及以上的可用区，至少需要添加2个可用区
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en:
The ID of the availability zone.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36064.html operation to query for available zones
fields.help_zh:
可用区ID。最多支持添加10个可用区。若当前地域支持2个及以上的可用区，至少需要添加2个可用区。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36064.html接口获取可用区ID对应的可用区的信息
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The mappings between availability zones and subnets. You can specify up to 10 availability zones. If the region has two or more availability zones, you must specify at least two
parameters.help_zh: 可用区及交换机映射列表，最多支持添加10个可用区。若当前地域支持2个及以上的可用区，至少需要添加2个可用区
parameters.name: zone_mappings

parameters.help_en:
The address allocation mode. Valid values:

Fixed (default): A static IP address is assigned to each availability zone.

Dynamic: An IP address is dynamically assigned to each availability zone.

Starting from <props="china">00:00:00 on February 25, 2025 (Beijing time)</props><props="intl">00:00:00 on February 25, 2025 (UTC+8)</props>, all instances created by calling this API will be https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2864070.html regardless of the mode you specify. IP modes are no longer distinguished, and the allocated IP addresses scale automatically. Existing ALB instances created before the upgrade are not affected
parameters.help_zh:
地址模式。取值 ：

Fixed（默认值）：固定IP模式，表示每个可用区分配固定IP地址。

Dynamic：动态IP模式，表示每个可用区动态分配IP地址。

自<props="china">北京时间2025年2月25日00:00:00</props><props="intl">2025年2月25日00:00:00 （UTC+8）</props>起，通过本接口新建实例时，无论您指定何种模式，实际均创建为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2864070.html，不再区分IP模式，分配的IP地址具备自动弹性能力；升级前的ALB实例不受影响
parameters.name: address_allocated_mode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The edition of the Application Load Balancer. Different editions have different features and billing policies. Valid values:

Basic: Basic edition.

Standard: Standard edition.

StandardWithWaf: WAF-enabled edition
parameters.help_zh:
应用型负载均衡的版本，不同版本有不同功能限制和计费策略。取值：

Basic：基础版。

Standard：标准版。

StandardWithWaf：WAF增强版
parameters.name: load_balancer_edition

fields.help_en: The ID of the shared bandwidth package that is associated with the public-facing instance
fields.help_zh: 公网类型实例关联的共享带宽包ID
fields.name: bandwidth_package_id

fields.help_en:
The billing method of the instance.

Set the value to PostPay for pay-as-you-go
fields.help_zh:
实例的计费类型。

仅取值PostPay：表示按量计费
fields.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en: The billing configuration of the Application Load Balancer instance
parameters.help_zh: 应用型负载均衡实例计费配置
parameters.name: load_balancer_billing_config

parameters.help_en:
The protocol version. Valid values:

IPv4: IPv4.

DualStack: The instance supports both IPv4 and IPv6
parameters.help_zh:
协议版本。取值：

IPv4：IPv4类型。
DualStack：双栈类型
parameters.name: address_ip_version

fields.help_en: The tag key. The key can be up to 128 characters long, cannot start with aliyun or acs:, and cannot contain http\:// or https\://
fields.help_zh: 最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含http://或https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The value can be up to 128 characters long, cannot start with aliyun or acs:, and cannot contain http\:// or https\://
fields.help_zh: 最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含http://或https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags to add to the instance
parameters.name: tag

fields.help_en: The ID of the security group
fields.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the security groups to associate with the instance
parameters.name: security_group_ids
